caption:
Momo has fallen for riding lessons, but her lower back and hips feel stiff every time she hops off.

Riding asks your trunk to follow the horse's movement, steady but not stiff. Trunk control and side-to-side balance matter as much as flexibility, and Pilates can be a helpful way to practise them.

Hybi's 1-minute routine: bird dog, pelvis level, hold 3 seconds, 8 each side, 3 times a week. Stop if pain gets worse.

Pain after a fall, tingling down a leg, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help you build a plan. Book online via the link in bio 🐎
